protocol: counterfactual_imagination_v1: Block-7 minimal experiment. Deterministic transition s'=(s+a+1) mod N; the agent experiences one path; counterfactual queries ask about the unseen action at experienced states. world_model generalizes the transition rule (median-shift), memory_only recalls only seen pairs. Criterion: world_model counterfactual accuracy >= 0.9 and >= memory_only + 0.3.
